sections.title: Life cycle and habitat
sections.text: A branched annual native to western and southern Europe, about 10–30 cm tall. It grows in dry open habitats and disturbed soils.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The basal leaves are spatulate; the corymbs bear small white or lilac flowers. The outer petals are larger and asymmetric. The flattened, notched silicles are about 4–6 mm long.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: The botanical sources consulted do not establish reliable food use.
